title: Kazamias building for the future at Kaz Hill Farm
note: NYRA describes Kazamias as an owner and breeder at Kaz Hill Farm and repeatedly identifies horses produced by that operation as his/their homebreds. Use for North American ownership-breeding descriptor semantics, not as a universal registration rule.

title: BHA confirms changes to Doncaster fixtures on Friday 25 April and Saturday 26 April
note: BHA repeatedly distinguishes Doncaster's round course from the straight mile/straight course in an operational fixture-change notice. Use for British course-layout terminology; exact geometry is venue-specific.

title: About Churchill Downs
note: Current official venue profile states Churchill Downs features a one-mile dirt oval track. Use for North American racecourse-geometry terminology.

title: TrackMaster Track Bias Reports
note: TrackMaster/Equibase describes Track Bias Reports as showing bias trends of winners and graded views of finishers for recent races. Use for handicapping-analysis terminology; do not model bias as an official physical track-condition code.

title: Hot Weather Procedures — Guidance Notes
note: BHA veterinary guidance explains thermoregulation and active cooling of horses around racing/exercise in hot weather. Use for post-race cooling semantics; detailed protocol is condition-specific.

title: Keeneland Championship Sale at Del Mar to Offer Lifetime Breeding Right to Leading Sire Nyquist
note: Keeneland states that the lifetime breeding right entitles the purchaser to breed one mare per season to Nyquist for the duration of the stallion's stud career. Contract terms can differ by offering.

title: Owner Education — Outcrossing and Nicking
note: TOBA explains outcross breeding as avoiding repeated presence within four or more generations and nicking as evaluating affinity/success between sire lines and broodmare-sire lines. Use as Thoroughbred breeding-industry semantics, not immutable genetic rules.
